title: CTRL control / HMI board (two-sided, 4 layers)
note: W2 PCB-CTRL: control / HMI board, two-sided, 4 layers (A-PCB-07). Top: the six TL3145 at the contract switch points, MCP23017 U301-U303, PI4IOE5V9555 U306, the HMI resistors and TVS and the two ENC headers at the cut-outs. Bottom: the THT harness headers (hand-soldered from the top; pin field + 1.0 mm kept free on the top), the Raspberry Pi Pico U305 (its 23.1 x 53.9 mm courtyard does not fit the top between the switch columns and the cut-outs), the buzzer, the LED and the small SMD parts. Iteration 2: scripted LAB5 feed, blower return and fan copper, GND plane vias, fan cluster re-placed. CI/model output of pcb/board_gen.py; not a fabrication release; bench gates OPEN.

layers.source: W2 CTRL-R layer study and W2 CTRL-4: 6 layers, JLC06161H-2116 1.6 mm (pcb/generated/stackup-6l.json and pcb/rules/jlc-6l-1oz.kicad_dru from pcb/stackup.py; jlcpcb.com/impedance read 2026-11-12): outer 1 oz, inner 0.5 oz. The contract stackup (mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json: t 1.6, layers 4, JLC04161H-7628) keeps the thickness 1.6 mm the mechanics use; its layer count is the 4-layer default of the other boards
layers.types_why: In1.Cu (L2) carries a solid GND plane and In4.Cu (L5) a solid 3V3_Q6A plane, both laid before routing and typed power, so the Specctra export marks them (type power) and Freerouting does not route on them; every SMD GND pad has its own scripted via to L2, every SMD 3V3_Q6A pad (or scripted 3V3_Q6A group) its own scripted via to L5, THT pads join the planes directly. Every routing layer faces a solid plane: F.Cu (L1) 0.2234 mm above L2, In2.Cu (L3) 0.3 mm below L2, In3.Cu (L4) 0.3 mm above L5, B.Cu (L6) 0.2234 mm below L5 (JLC06161H-2116; the SIG/GND/SIG/SIG/PWR/SIG order of the typical 6-layer stackup on jlcpcb.com/6-layer-pcb, read 2026-11-12, with L3/L4 as signal pair). In3.Cu is the routing layer the 6-layer stackup adds. Route run 43183047190 (In3.Cu and In4.Cu both routing layers, 3V3_Q6A routed) gave 1 error and 27 unconnected (3V3_Q6A 16) against 1 and 15 on 4 layers (43136394379), so 3V3_Q6A became a plane. The power classes route on F.Cu/B.Cu only (router.class_layers), as pcb/check_boards.py requires (netclasses.json: no inner copper for PWR3A, 1.8 mm inner for PWR1A).

plan.F.Cu: L1: top parts, signals, scripted LAB5 trunk J305 -> J314.2 (1.85 mm) and the 1.85 mm C342 branch to its four vias, scripted 3V3_Q6A pieces (right pull-up column, MCP pins, the C302-C306 row, stubs to the L5 plane vias), scripted E3_PICO3V3 pieces (HMI2/HMI3 bus along cut-out 1 to the L4 link via, R334/R335, the HMI pull-up row to C312 and U306, R361/R362), PWR1A routes, GND pour after routing
plan.In1.Cu: L2: GND plane (pre-route zone, DSN plane), no signals
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signals, GND pour after routing (no LAB5 copper since W2 CTRL-4)
plan.In3.Cu: L4 (added by the 6-layer stackup, W2 CTRL-R): signals, the scripted E3_PICO3V3 link up the right strip (between the J316 pins, past C302/C304, beside the cut-out 1 edge to the via at the HMI bus end) with its branch to R395, the C312-R335 link, GND pour after routing
plan.In4.Cu: L5 (added by the 6-layer stackup, W2 CTRL-R): solid 3V3_Q6A plane (pre-route zone, DSN plane), no signals
plan.B.Cu: L6: bottom parts, signals, scripted E3_BLOWER_GND rail and E3_FAN5 (1.85 mm) and the E3_BLOWER_GND capacitor branches, the 1.85 mm LAB5 feeds of W2 CTRL-4 (LAB5-FEED-D: J314.2, D306, under the Pico, D301, up the right strip to C320/R367/Q304; LAB5-FEED-U: J305.3 up the left edge to C321/U315/C322; C343, C342), scripted E3_PICO3V3 pieces (R4B bus along cut-out 2, up the right strip and along the top edge to J312.4, branch to R362; Pico pin 36 escape via, R330/R327/C308), locked GND copper over the custom Pico GND pads, PWR1A routes, GND pour after routing

rules_note: Rules live in the committed CTRL.kicad_pro: the project defaults of pcb/generated/netclasses.json project_defaults (track 0.15 / clearance 0.15, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15) with router vias 0.7 / 0.3 (0.6 mm vias at 0.15 mm clearance sit 0.45 mm hole to hole, PCB-PWRB lesson), and the classes PWR1A (0.35 mm: E3_FAN5_P, E3_GNSS5V), PWR3A_BRANCH (LAB5: 1.85 mm since W2 CTRL-4, the PWR3A class width; every LAB5 pad is reached by scripted copper), SCRIPTED_GND (GND and, on 6 layers, the plane net 3V3_Q6A) and SCRIPTED_PWR3A (E3_FAN5, E3_BLOWER_GND), the last two not autorouted. check_boards widths follow netclasses.json (LAB5, E3_BLOWER_GND, E3_FAN5: PWR3A 1.85 mm outer; the E3_BLOWER_GND capacitor branches in branch_exempt). rules_file stays null (board_gen does not copy .kicad_dru files yet); the 6-layer rule file of the same defaults is pcb/rules/jlc-6l-1oz.kicad_dru (W2 CTRL-R).

router.why: route run 42423914214 (fan-out on, power classes autorouted) stopped at 60 unrouted connections with 20 DRC errors (dangling fan-out vias, off-centre GND joints, LAB5 with 12 open connections): fan-out off, GND and E3_FAN5 scripted. Route run 43100344071 (34 min): 2 errors (router tracks too close to the custom Pico GND pads 8 and 13, the DSN carries the anchor only) and 8 unconnected (5 LAB5 branches): locked GND copper now covers the custom Pico GND pads. Route runs 43106410728 (a locked L3 LAB5 run across the board) and 43111037016 (LAB5 branches on L3 at 0.6 mm): DRC errors 0, but the router stalled with 36-37 of the 3V3_Q6A connections open once L3 carried LAB5. LAB5 now uses short scripted islands (one 18 mm L3 piece to D301) and the router joins them on L1/L4 at 0.5 mm. Route run 43114111838 (that setting): LAB5 complete, DRC errors 0, but 34 of the 3V3_Q6A connections still open: the left pull-up column R308-R319 now has a scripted 3V3_Q6A bus on L3 with a via beside each pad 2, and the Pico GND vias sit under the module instead of in the escape channels between and outside the castellated pads. Route run 43118391983 (that setting): 1 error (a router neck at U313.1) and 25 unconnected, 15 of them 3V3_Q6A: the right pull-up column, the MCP VDD-to-address-pin links and a via for the boxed-in U315.3 are scripted too. Route run 43121860459 (that setting): DRC errors 0 and 22 unconnected (E3_PICO3V3 14, E3_ENC1_A/B 4, E3_BLOWER_GND 2, E3_FN_EXT 1, E3_ENC2_A 1), most of them at pads that could not leave their row: the pull-up rows R4B and HMI3 have their series resistors turned and a scripted E3_PICO3V3 bus along the cut-out edge, R344 is turned so that its E3_FN pin sits next to R343, E3_PICO3V3 has scripted pieces at the Pico, C312, R361/R362, R368 and R395, and E3_BLOWER_GND is fully scripted (class SCRIPTED_PWR3A). Route run 43131682520 (that setting): 1 error (the R4B bus end dangling) and 13 unconnected (E3_PICO3V3 8, E3_BACK_EXT 2, E3_FAN_EN 1, E3_GNSS5V 1, 3V3_Q6A 1): the R4B bus now runs up the right strip to J312.4 with branches to R362 and, on L1, to the HMI3 branch; the HMI pull-ups R337/R339/R341 are joined in the gap between their pad rows to C312 and U306; the scripted links that walled in BACK_EXT and the PICO column (C312 to R334, Pico pin 36 around the column) are gone, Pico pin 36 has an escape via. Route run 43136394379 (that setting): 1 error (the scripted 3V3_Q6A via at U315.3 left dangling) and 15 unconnected (3V3_Q6A 8, E3_PANEL_TEMP 2, E3_CASE_TEMP 2, E3_PICO3V3 1, E3_Q6A_KEY_GATE 1, E3_REC_EXT 1); five runs gave 13-22 unconnected because every scripted fix moved Freerouting failures to other nets at the saturated band entrances beside cut-out 1 (W2 CTRL-R study). Its router copper is now frozen and locked (build/kicad/boards/CTRL/route-frozen.json) and completed by a scripted grid A* pass with the exact clearance check (build/kicad/boards/CTRL/freeze/freeze_route.py): the V33-U315 via and stub and the P33-RIGHT-F link are dropped, E3_PICO3V3 crosses the cut-out 1 band on L2 between the vias P33-V-R4B and P33-V-R368, the router copper of 15 nets is ripped where the completion needed its place (112 of 2278 segments and 14 of 234 vias with their dangling ends) and those nets are joined again, and L2 carries 5 slow signals where three layers had no path (E3_PICO3V3 35.6 mm, E3_PICO_SWCLK 21.2 mm, E3_REC_EXT 14.9 mm, PG_BONI 4.7 mm, E3_MARK_EXT 4.4 mm). Freerouting finds no open connection of its own to route, so a re-route of the same inputs gives the same copper. CTRL-R route runs: 43189431817 (12 errors: a completion via in the Pico SWCLK pad, whose copper the SMD drill offset moves by 0.8 mm, and 8 track ends off via centres), 43199848180 (2 errors), 43204137006 (6 errors: the Pico TP7 footprint keepout, a dangling router stub) and 43206372346 (DRC 0 errors, 0 unconnected, ignored [], about 4.5 min; check-mode run 43207377886 green), each with 0 unconnected; Freerouting still adds 69-72 redundant short wires per run, DRC-clean. After the completion the cut-out 1 band has no spare 0.15 mm crossing on L1/L3/L4 (model): any pad, net or scripted-copper change stops make_spec at the guard of route-frozen.json and needs a new harvest. Job timeout 34 min inside the 45 min CI job W2 CTRL-R layer study (6 layers, JLC06161H-2116): route run 43183047190 (In3.Cu and In4.Cu as routing layers) 1 error and 27 unconnected (3V3_Q6A 16); In4.Cu became a solid 3V3_Q6A plane with a scripted via per SMD pad or scripted group (3V3_Q6A in class SCRIPTED_GND, not autorouted): route run 43185702454 DRC 0 errors, ignored [], 4 unconnected; route run 43190774090 (with a 1.35 mm F.Cu/B.Cu LAB5 feed of Q304) DRC 0 errors, 4 unconnected (E3_MCP_RESET_N 3, E3_PICO3V3 1). W2 CTRL-4 on the CTRL-R board-of-record inputs: 6 layers, the 4-layer frozen route (route-frozen.json) does not apply; the whole right LAB5 group and D306 are fed on B.Cu at the PWR3A class width 1.85 mm without vias (LAB5-FEED-D: J314.2, under the Pico, D301.2, up the right strip to Q304.2, C320.1 and R367.2; LAB5-FEED-U: J305.3 up the left edge to C321.1, U315.1 and C322.1), C342/C343 at 1.85 mm too, the L3 run is gone; Q303, R367, C320 and C322 moved for the feed; the E3_PICO3V3 link up the right strip and the R395 branch run on L4 (In3.Cu), the C312 group joins R335 on L4. Class PWR3A_BRANCH (LAB5) has the track width 1.85 mm, so any router copper of LAB5 is at the class width.
